title: Generated Evaluation Suites as Diversity-Driven Search for Real Agent Regressions
abstract: arXiv:2611.17632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating an evaluation suite from an agent's specification is diversity-driven search: a generator fills a descriptor space (requirements $\times$ personas $\times$ scenario kinds), and the suite it emits is an archive, then scored like a benchmark by its mean pass rate, which throws away the search's product. We inject 7 controlled defects into a $\tau^2$-bench agent across two domains. Coverage yields a ceiling: if a defect's traced footprint holds $b$ scenarios that pass at baseline, it can itself contribute at most $b/N$ to a suite of $N$. For 4 of 5 traceable defects that ceiling lies at or below the detection threshold $\theta = 0.10$, so no within-footprint effect can move the suite past it; in both domains the tool-removal defect destroys every covered scenario it can (exactly its ceiling) while the suite-level pass rate moves the other way. translated_title: 生成的评估套件：面向真实智能体回归问题的多样性驱动搜索
translated_abstract: 从智能体规范生成评估套件本质上是一种多样性驱动的搜索：生成器填充一个描述符空间（需求 × 用户角色 × 场景类型），其产出的套件构成一个存档，随后像基准测试一样按平均通过率进行评分，而这丢弃了搜索本身的成果。我们在两个领域向一个 τ²-bench 智能体注入了 7 个受控缺陷。覆盖度产生了一个上限：若某缺陷的追踪足迹包含 b 个在基线下通过的场景，则它对规模为 N 的套件的贡献至多为 b/N。在 5 个可追踪的缺陷中，有 4 个的上限位于或低于检测阈值 θ = 0.10，因此足迹内的任何效应都无法使套件通过率越过该阈值；在两个领域中，工具移除类缺陷摧毁了它所能摧毁的全部覆盖场景（恰好等于其上限），而套件级别的通过率却朝相反方向移动。缺陷分为两种情形：追踪对齐的缺陷，其中逐单元格评分能够恢复……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文将从智能体规范自动生成评估套件视为多样性驱动搜索，并通过注入受控缺陷证明覆盖度上限使多数可追踪缺陷无法被套件级平均通过率检测到，进而提出按场景单元格评分以发现真实的智能体回归缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper frames automatic evaluation-suite generation from agent specifications as diversity-driven search and shows, through controlled defect injection, that a coverage-imposed ceiling renders most traceable agent regressions undetectable by suite-level mean pass rate, motivating per-cell scoring to surface real regressions.
